intent.description: AI Signal daily digest for Agent users — tracks top AI builders on X, podcasts, official AI-lab blogs (Anthropic / OpenAI / DeepMind), and arXiv papers, then remixes central JSON feeds into a personalized digest. Use when the user wants AI/investing insights, asks to install ai-signal (FastAgent or generic agents), or invokes /ai-signal. No content API keys required.

trust.remote_metadata_policy: allow feed and source metadata; forbid unreviewed execution

permissions.network: fetch central JSON feeds from GitHub and jsDelivr CDN mirrors only; delivery to Telegram / Feishu / email only when the user supplies delivery credentials and asks for it
permissions.file_write: user configuration under ~/.ai-signal/ and its prompts/, feedback.jsonl; never replace user config while refreshing the runtime checkout
permissions.subprocess: python3 for the bundled scripts (prepare_digest.py, deliver.py, feedback.py, render_digest.py) and transcription backends; no arbitrary code execution
permissions.interactive: avoid unless delivery platform auth requires it

scaffold: SKILL.md frontmatter with name and description
README hook and natural trigger examples
clear exclusions (one-off summaries are not digests)
production: install and README verification (npx skills add and git clone paths)
no content API keys required from users
library: trust boundary (central service fetches; user agent digests; feedback stays local)
governed: rollback boundary (runtime checkout refresh never replaces ~/.ai-signal/ config)
public claim guard (feed freshness and coverage claims match tests)
README, MIT LICENSE, and install evidence verified

evidence_boundary.public_claim_policy: claim only what local validation, install proof, human review, or provider-backed evidence actually supports
